bio: Pyla's been working on Magmablood trains from as soon as she could lift a furnacesword. She captains the best crew on the track – the Skink squashing record holders. While proud of her achievements, Pyla's not convinced it's all down to her. There's something about the glowing face on her fumebanner that seems so... entrancing.
